from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):\n    n = len(grid)\n    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]\n    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]\n    halfturn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]\n    return [\n        [*grid[r], *clockwise[r]] for r in range(n)\n    ] + [\n        [*counterclockwise[r], *halfturn[r]] for r in range(n)\n    ]\n'''
path=base/'task-8182fbf6.py'
path.write_text(program)

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskmod',path)
